name: deployment-scaffolding
description: Provisions AWS IAM deployment roles from a repository's Terraform (least-privilege policy plus a permissions boundary, additive-merge only), scaffolds a new repo's infra/deploy skeleton from a per-type template with token substitution, and registers an OIDC login client in AWS IAM Identity Center so an app's "Login with AWS" button works (never Cognito). Every skill interviews, then executes a deterministic tool rather than improvising AWS CLI calls.
